ops.note: 881c186. service/controller.go:572 retries only on launchctlInFlux; every other kind is terminal. InFlux has exactly two producers, exits 36 and 37 (launchctl.go:72), because launchd's own error table calls them 'Operation now in progress' / 'Operation already in progress' — launchd saying the call can later succeed, rather than an exit code guessed at. Exit 5 is an aggregate batch code and is deliberately Unknown(code).
